description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing integrations, including loading webhooks, commands, OAuth apps, and handling interactive dialogs in Mattermost.

methods.name: loadIncomingHooksAndProfilesForTeam
methods.description: Loads incoming webhooks and associated user profiles for a specified team.

methods.name: loadProfilesForIncomingHooks
methods.description: Loads user profiles for a list of incoming webhooks if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadOutgoingHooksAndProfilesForTeam
methods.description: Loads outgoing webhooks and associated user profiles for a specified team.

methods.name: loadProfilesForOutgoingHooks
methods.description: Loads user profiles for a list of outgoing webhooks if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadCommandsAndProfilesForTeam
methods.description: Loads custom commands and associated user profiles for a team.

methods.name: loadProfilesForCommands
methods.description: Loads user profiles for a list of commands if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadOAuthAppsAndProfiles
methods.description: Loads OAuth applications and associated user profiles.

methods.name: loadProfilesForOAuthApps
methods.description: Loads user profiles for OAuth apps if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadOutgoingOAuthConnectionsAndProfiles
methods.description: Loads outgoing OAuth connections and associated user profiles.

methods.name: loadProfilesForOutgoingOAuthConnections
methods.description: Loads user profiles for outgoing OAuth connections if not already loaded.

methods.name: submitInteractiveDialog
methods.description: Submits an interactive dialog, injecting channel, user, and team IDs from state or dialog arguments.

methods.name: lookupInteractiveDialog
methods.description: Looks up options for an interactive dialog, injecting channel ID from dialog arguments if available.
